what: What the design site's Vehicles review page shows for this car (R126). tools/vehicles/review/build.mjs turns this, vehicle.json, the bake and assets/profiles/<id>.json into art/ui/poc/vehicles/<id>/; tools/vehicles/review/check.mjs fails if any Vehicles-contract item is missing. Paths are repo-relative.
name: Hawk Dash
summary: Third likeness pass: wider lower stance, body widening starts lower, sloping shoulders above the wheels, narrower upper cabin, and a rounded nose in plan. Lamps sit closer to the reference shapes and heights; exhaust outlets are closer together. Cheap wheels retained; triangles 2702 / 879 / 597 within 2800 / 900 / 600. New reference-derived tests check local width, shoulder slope, nose taper, lamps/outlets and camera setup at every LOD. Collision hulls and handling retained.
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.

specTwin.sharedSpec: One spec, two bodies (R123): the Hawk Dash and the Lion President name spec 'aussie-v8' in web/shared/src/roster.json, and their profiles' handling (tuning) is identical, held by tools/vehicles/test/spec-twins.test.mjs. Rear drive, 1700 kg, Cruz-like launch, more power per kilo for a higher top speed; the bodies (hull, wheels, damage parts) are each car's own.

reference.note: Previous and revised models use the SAME corrected horizontal camera at car midpoint. Shaded views and silhouette diffs now share perspective projection. Front/rear use a long-lens 50 m distance; 3/4 views are horizontal at 0.78 m, instead of the old elevated views. Generated reference sheets are unchanged and are not calibrated photographs. Enlarged FRONT/REAR rows lead each sheet. Weighted IoU at the corrected camera: .9392 → .9486 / .9391 → .9526 / .9412 → .9497. New local likeness tests pass all tiers and reject the previous model; owner likeness judgement is still needed. See validation report for commands and failure-injection evidence.
